notes: A quality release from a full pass over every screen. Charts now work with no internet (the chart library ships inside GOAT). Errors appear as small messages in the corner instead of browser pop-ups, in your language. The browser's Back and Forward buttons move between the sessions you opened. A session that fails to load shows a banner with Retry, the map says "loading the lap" until it is drawn, and a session with only pit laps explains why there is no map. The Setups tab and Compare follow the session you have open. Tab stays inside an open panel, and on a phone the session list sits above the page. Everything from 0.9.179 is included.
